headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6, including subdivisions (1) through (4), plus history note. Lists the four exclusive grounds on which the committee may by majority vote suspend a rulemaking order prior to final filing.

headings.title: Bar on filing or publishing disapproved rules
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 7 and history note. Bars the department from filing and the secretary of state from publishing in the Missouri Register any disapproved rule or portion.

headings.title: Committee disapproval reports and legislative ratification
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 8 and history note. Requires the committee to report disapproval findings to the senate and house and keeps disapproved rules from taking effect if ratified by resolution in each house within thirty legislative days.

headings.title: Legislative suspension or revocation of adopted rules
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 9 and history note. Describes archived text allowing legislative suspension or revocation of adopted rules by bill or Article IV, Section 8 concurrent resolution on committee recommendation, committee hearings under section 536.037, and Missouri Register publication.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.509:14283, all three subsections, and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 5), and verified all fingerprints. Verified director entry for suppression/eradication, warrantless daylight inspections between sunrise and sunset, and judicial entry warrants on proper cause; retained all three titles.

headings.title: Director entry authority for suppression and eradication activities
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 5). Authorizes the director to enter cotton fields, cotton processing facilities, and other premises for suppression or eradication activities including pesticide treatment, monitoring, and destruction of growing cotton or host plants.

headings.title: Warrantless daylight inspections for boll weevil infestation
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Authorizes department inspection of fields, premises, and property for boll weevil infestation in a reasonable manner without a warrant during reasonable daylight hours between sunrise and sunset.

headings.title: Court warrants for right of entry
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Authorizes any judge within jurisdiction, upon proper cause shown, to issue an entry warrant for section 263.509 or sections 263.500 to 263.537 activities.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.515:14285, both subsections, and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 7), and verified all fingerprints. Verified in-state quarantine, storage, handling, and movement rules versus inbound out-of-state regulated-article rules; revised subsection 1 to include regulated-article storage and movement and retained subsection 2.

headings.title: In-state quarantine and regulated-article storage and movement rules
headings.reviewNote: Independently reviewed complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 7). Revised title to include regulated-article movement into or from quarantined areas alongside storage and handling; covers permissive department regulations quarantining all or part of Missouri when necessary or reasonably necessary to prevent or retard boll weevil spread.

headings.title: Regulations on regulated articles from infested states
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Authorizes department regulations governing movement of regulated articles into Missouri from states or portions of states known to be infested with the boll weevil.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.517:14286, all five subsections, and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 8), and verified all fingerprints. Checked eradication zone designations, planting location restrictions, archived "elimination zones" versus "eradication zones" wording in subsection 3, three-week newspaper notice, and noncompliant cotton destruction; revised subsection 3 to reflect permissive zone rules and retained subsections 1, 2, 4, and 5.

headings.title: Designation of boll weevil eradication zones
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 8). Authorizes the department to designate one or more areas of Missouri by regulation as eradication zones.

headings.title: Restrictions on cotton planting locations in eradication zones
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Authorizes reasonable regulations restricting areas where cotton cannot be planted within an eradication zone when planting would jeopardize program success or present a public health or safety hazard.

headings.title: Zone rules on noncommercial cotton and commercial grower participation
headings.reviewNote: Independently reviewed complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Revised title to reflect permissive regulatory authority rather than a self-executing ban while remaining neutral on archived "elimination zones" versus "eradication zones" wording; covers regulations prohibiting noncommercial cotton planting in "elimination zones" and requiring commercial cotton growers in eradication zones to participate in eradication programs including prescribed cost sharing.

headings.title: Newspaper publication notice of zone prohibitions and requirements
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Requires newspaper publication of subsection 3 prohibitions and requirements one day each week for three successive weeks in the affected area.

headings.title: Destruction of noncompliant cotton in eradication zones
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and history note. Authorizes the department in eradication zones to destroy cotton not in compliance with department regulations when a grower fails to meet them.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.520:14287, all three subsections, and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 9), and verified all fingerprints. Verified treatment/destruction of volunteer/noncommercial cotton, commercial cotton purchase/destruction procedures, bar on payment for post-notice or noncompliant cotton, and payment for pre-notice cotton losses; retained all three titles.

headings.title: Treating or destroying noncommercial cotton and purchasing commercial cotton
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 9). Authorizes destroying or pesticide-treating volunteer or noncommercial cotton and establishing procedures to purchase and destroy commercial cotton in eradication zones when deemed necessary under sections 263.500 to 263.537.

headings.title: No payment for post-notice or noncompliant cotton losses
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Bars department payment to owners or lessees for destruction or injury of cotton planted in an eradication zone after published notice or handled in violation of sections 263.500 to 263.537 or regulations.

headings.title: Payment for losses to cotton planted before notice
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Requires department payment for losses resulting from destroying cotton planted in eradication zones prior to promulgation of notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.523:14288, all five subsections including subdivisions 2(1)–(2) and 4(1)–(4), and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 10), and verified all fingerprints. Verified organization certification, 501(a) nonprofit/open membership, one-vote class, governor-appointed nine-member board, staggered terms, and department audit access; revised subsection 5 to "Board member terms" to avoid confusion with the department director and retained subsections 1–4.

headings.title: Certification of cotton growers' organization for program agreements
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 10). Requires department certification of a cotton growers' organization to enter agreements with Missouri, other states, the federal government, and other parties under sections 263.500 to 263.537.

headings.title: Nonprofit status and open-membership certification requirements
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2, including subdivisions (1) and (2), plus history note. Requires an eligible organization to demonstrate nonprofit status able to qualify as tax exempt under Internal Revenue Code Section 501(a) and membership open to all Missouri cotton growers.

headings.title: Single membership class and one-vote-per-member rule
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Limits the organization to one class of members with one vote per member.

headings.title: Board of directors composition and gubernatorial appointment
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4, including subdivisions (1) through (4), plus history note. Specifies gubernatorial appointment of the nine-member board from recommendations by the department, largest general farm organization, and largest cotton producer organization.

headings.title: Board member terms and department audit of organization records
headings.reviewNote: Independently reviewed complete text of subsection 5 and history note. Revised title from "Director terms" to "Board member terms" to avoid confusion with the department director; covers three-year terms with staggered initial one-, two-, and three-year terms and department inspection or audit of organization books, records of account, and minutes at any reasonable time.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.525:14289, all three subsections, and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 11), and verified all fingerprints. Verified official certification upon section 263.523 compliance, limited scope preserving other groups, single-organization limit, and revocation authority; retained all three titles.

headings.title: Certification as official cotton growers' organization
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 11). Requires department certification as the official cotton growers' organization upon determining compliance with section 263.523.

headings.title: Limited scope of certification and effect on other groups
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Limits certification to sections 263.500 to 263.537 purposes and preserves other cotton grower organizations established for other purposes.

headings.title: Single-organization limit and certification revocation
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Restricts certification to one organization and authorizes revocation if the organization fails to meet sections 263.500 to 263.537 requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.527:14290, all eight subsections, and notes (A.L. 1998 H.B. 1859 merged with S.B. 945; split effective dates 7-10-98 S.B. 945 and 8-28-98 H.B. 1859), and verified all fingerprints. Confirmed subsection 1 body authorizes a "statewide referendum" with a regionally designed program despite the official catchline "Regional referendum", plus per-acre assessments, eligibility, mailed ballots, two-thirds approval, remittance, annual CPA audit, and non-state trust fund exempt from section 33.080; retained all eight titles.

headings.title: Statewide assessment referendum and regional program design
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 12, A.L. 1998 H.B. 1859 merged with S.B. 945; Effective 7-10-98 S.B. 945, 8-28-98 H.B. 1859). Preserves the archived text authorizing a statewide referendum at the certified organization's request while designing the program on a regional basis (official catchline says "Regional referendum").

headings.title: Per-acre assessment basis, terms, and implementing regulations
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Bases assessments on planted cotton acreage in the eradication area, directs the department in consultation with the section 263.523 board to determine amount, duration, levy method, payment timing, and area, and limits regulations to those necessary.

headings.title: Voter entitlement and eligibility determinations
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and notes. Entitles all affected cotton growers to one vote and assigns eligibility determinations to the department after consulting the certified organization.

headings.title: Mailed referendum ballots for eligible growers
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and notes. Requires mailing a ballot to each eligible cotton grower to vote for or against the program.

headings.title: Two-thirds approval threshold and assessment collection
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and notes. Conditions department assessment collection from affected growers on at least two-thirds of those voting approving the assessment.

headings.title: Remittance of collected assessments to certified organization
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6 and notes. Requires prompt remittance of collected assessments to the certified organization under department terms ensuring use in a sound eradication or suppression program.

headings.title: Annual certified public accountant audit of organization
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 7 and notes. Requires the certified organization to provide the department an annual CPA audit of its accounts.

headings.title: Special trust fund, investment, records, and non-reversion
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 8 and notes. Declares assessments non-state funds deposited in a special trust fund held by the director, invested under sections 30.250, 30.260, and 30.270, with records open to organization officers and unexpended balances exempt from section 33.080 general-revenue transfer.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.531:14292, all three subsections, and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 14, A.L. 2002 H.B. 1348 merged with S.B. 865), and verified all fingerprints. Checked subsequent referendums after failed votes with department consent, ten-year continuation votes after passage, and application of initial referendum requirements; retained all three titles.

headings.title: Subsequent referendums after a failed vote
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 14, A.L. 2002 H.B. 1348 merged with S.B. 865). Authorizes the certified organization, with department consent, to call additional referendums if a referendum fails to receive required affirmative votes.

headings.title: Ten-year continuation votes after referendum approval
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Allows eligible voters, after passage of any referendum, to vote at least every ten years on continuing assessments.

headings.title: Initial referendum requirements applied to subsequent votes
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Requires subsequent referendums to satisfy all requirements governing an initial referendum.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 263.534:14293, all four subsections, and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 15, A.L. 2004 S.B. 740, et al.), and verified all fingerprints. Verified per-acre penalties, 30-day crop destruction and public nuisance abatement, court condemnation/bond-free injunctions, and subsection 4 assessment lien (60-day perfection, 30-day FSA/first-handler notice retaining archived "date of perfections", UCC Article 9 exclusion under sections 400.9-101 to 400.9-508, and priority over prior liens/encumbrances/mortgages); retained all four titles.

headings.title: Per-acre penalties for unpaid assessments
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1995 S.B. 66 § 15, A.L. 2004 S.B. 740, et al.). Subjects cotton growers who fail to pay assessments when due upon reasonable notice to regulatory per-acre penalties in addition to the assessment.

headings.title: Mandatory crop destruction and public nuisance abatement
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Requires growers failing to pay assessments and penalties within thirty days of penalty notice to destroy assessed cotton plants, and deems undestroyed plants a public nuisance subject to abatement.

headings.title: Court condemnation petitions and bond-free injunctive relief
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Authorizes department circuit court petitions to condemn and destroy the public nuisance at the grower's cost and grants injunctive relief without bond notwithstanding other legal remedies.

headings.title: Assessment lien attachment, notices, UCC exclusion, and priority
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Establishes an assessment lien attaching and perfected sixty days after mailed assessment notice on current and future cotton crops and sale proceeds, requires thirty-day notice to the FSA and first handlers ("date of perfections" in archived text), excludes the lien from UCC Article 9 (sections 400.9-101 to 400.9-508), and gives preference over prior liens, encumbrances, or mortgages.
